title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jerry Moore; mastered: AKG 1000e > Sony TC-110 TDK c-120sd’s (re-shelled for transfer); Nakamichi Dragon > Benchmark ADC1 24/96 > Tascam HD-P2, compact flash > Mac > Adobe Audition CC > Flac; transferred and seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Clear‑sounding audience tape of a hot 1973 show with high energy and a standout "I Know You Rider"
ai_review.review: The recording captures the concert’s excitement with clear instrumentation, though the crowd is audible enough to turn off listeners who dislike audience noise. Fans praised the overall energy and highlighted the powerful rendition of “I Know You Rider,” noting it as one of their favorites from this era.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single detailed review, but it rates the show 4 stars and praises both performance and sound quality; weighted toward strong musical energy with decent recording clarity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear sounding mix that captures the band well, but includes noticeable crowd noise which may bother listeners who prefer pure soundboard tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall high‑energy performance; reviewer notes surprise at the absence of Sugaree but otherwise finds the show tight and enjoyable.
